name: SPY overnight hold (x-bookmark scan, rank 1)
hypothesis: Holding SPY across the overnight gap (buy close, sell next open) captures the positive overnight drift of large-cap index equities better than intraday exposure.

rules.entry: Buy at close of day T.
rules.exit: Sell at open of day T+1.
rules.position_sizing: All-in/out per night in the scan model.
rules.risk_limits: None in scan model; JARVIS gates apply.
rules.fees_and_slippage_model: Gross of commission/slippage in gate reasons — a real implementation pays the close/open spread + financing.

known_failure_modes: 23.2% Monte Carlo 95th drawdown exceeds the 6.0% floor
Gross PnL overstates an implementable version: close/open spread + financing not modeled
